question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Get top 3 combined points overall with just constructor name and year
WITH constructor_pts AS (
    SELECT r.year, cr.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(cr.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id, c.name
),
best_driver_pts AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, 
           MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM (
        SELECT r.year, cr.constructor_id, cr.driver_id, SUM(cr.points) as driver_points
        FROM results cr
        JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
        GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id, cr.driver_id
    )
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT cp.year, cp.constructor_id, cp.name, cp.constructor_points, COALESCE(bdp.best_driver_points, 0) as best_driver_points,
           cp.constructor_points + COALESCE(bdp.best_driver_points, 0) as combined_points
    FROM constructor_pts cp
    LEFT JOIN best_driver_pts bdp ON cp.constructor_id = bdp.constructor_id AND cp.year = bdp.year
)
SELECT name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

args.sql:
-- Get top 3 combined points overall with just constructor name and year
WITH constructor_pts AS (
    SELECT r.year, cr.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(cr.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id, c.name
),
best_driver_pts AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, 
           MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points
    FROM (
        SELECT r.year, cr.constructor_id, cr.driver_id, SUM(cr.points) as driver_points
        FROM results cr
        JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
        GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id, cr.driver_id
    )
    GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT cp.year, cp.constructor_id, cp.name, cp.constructor_points, COALESCE(bdp.best_driver_points, 0) as best_driver_points,
           cp.constructor_points + COALESCE(bdp.best_driver_points, 0) as combined_points
    FROM constructor_pts cp
    LEFT JOIN best_driver_pts bdp ON cp.constructor_id = bdp.constructor_id AND cp.year = bdp.year
)
SELECT name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
